name: @playform/hook-dsh-normalize-invisible
description: The invisible hook: a DeepSeek Harness plugin that hooks the llm/stream waterfall — the interceptable wrapper around EVERY streaming model call — and normalizes the zero-width/invisible character family (U+00AD soft hyphen, U+200B–U+200F zero-width spaces/joiners and directional marks, U+202A–U+202E bidi embedding controls, U+2060 word joiner, U+FEFF zero-width no-break space/BOM) in model output streams, the family's invisible flavor — the CLASS flavor: the core's Invisible class replaced by the configurable replacement string (default "" — REMOVAL), applied to text/reasoning deltas and assembled block-end blocks while tool-call deltas pass through untouched.
